text: Flexicar, described by El Confidencial as Spain's leading used-car dealer network, is owned by Luis Oliver Cornago, who reorganised the group's companies under Flexicar Internacional. Separately, the group received a capital injection of over EUR 7.6m into a related holding, Flexicar Investment SL, to launch a business-leasing line; the article does not attribute that injection to Flexicar Internacional specifically or confirm it was Cornago's personal money.

source.name: El Confidencial - 'Flexicar fusiona sus firmas bajo el paraguas internacional'; Spanish Wikipedia 'Flexicar (Espana)'
source.quote: Su dueño, Luis Oliver Cornago, ha decidido fusionar las principales sociedades del grupo bajo el paraguas de Flexicar Internacional
